reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gets `@Version private Long version`. The new changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to support_ticket. Both match the interface, and hidden acceptance tests pass 2/2 with a green build.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset follows the conventions: 2026/09/ path, DD-MM-YYYY name, changeset header, rollback, and include appended last with a `<!-- September 2026: ... -->` comment. The tests went into existing SupportTicketEntityUnitTest, not a new MockitoExtension *UnitTest class.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one entity field, one new changeset, one changelog include. It reuses the existing @Version pattern found in the applied-opportunity changeset. No existing changeset was edited and nothing outside the task was touched.
reasons.test_quality: The two added tests only check that version is null initially and that the getter/setter round-trips. Nothing pins the @Version annotation or conflict behaviour. The tests assert almost nothing about optimistic locking.
reasons.graph_use: The first graph query located the support/ticket files. A second graph query on db/changelog found little. The locking example and changelog tail came from grep and tail, so navigation relied mostly on text search.
